sections.title: Cons
sections.narration: Downsides next: sugar density is a major category problem. Fruit is supposed to moderate sugar with fibre and payoff, and dates push the sugar side extremely hard. Glycemic behaviour is rough for fruit. Much weaker fit than fruits with gentler carb behaviour. Dried-fruit concentration makes the sugar hit even harsher. This is the cleanest reason dates should remain below ordinary whole fruits like grapes.
